seo.title: The Atelier — NOIR Bespoke, Atlanta
seo.description: The NOIR atelier — a by-appointment bespoke tailoring house in Atlanta. Full-canvas construction, hand-padded lapels, and one client at a time.

header.title:
Bespoke is a ritual,
not a purchase.
header.sub: We cater to the connoisseur of fine tailoring — those who command distinction and elegance. What follows is not a shop. It is a room, a craft, and a single pair of hands kept for you alone.

founder.imageAlt: Jay, master tailor and founder of NOIR, in the atelier
founder.heading: Rooted in a tradition of excellence.
body: NOIR was founded on a single obsession — that a suit should be built, not bought. Jay trained his eye on the disciplines that machines cannot replicate: the roll of a hand-padded lapel, the balance of a shoulder, the quiet architecture beneath the cloth that lets a man forget he is wearing anything at all.

Every commission is understood as a personal narrative and reflected in every thread of the work — realised through the hands of master tailors, and delivered with the utmost discretion through our concierge service.
founder.pullQuote: In a world of abundance, stand singular in style.

items.title: Full-Canvas Construction
items.desc: A floating horsehair canvas, never fused — so the jacket moulds to your chest and improves with every wear.

items.title: Hand-Padded Lapels
items.desc: Each lapel is stitched by hand to earn its roll — the single detail that separates bespoke from the rest.

items.title: One Client at a Time
items.desc: The atelier receives a single guest per appointment. Unhurried, private, and entirely yours.

items.title: The Fabric Library
items.desc: Over a thousand cloths from heritage English and Italian mills — worsteds, flannels, silks and stretch wools.

items.title: Thirty-Plus Measurements
items.desc: Posture, stance and the way you move are recorded into a body profile kept for every future commission.

items.title: Concierge Service
items.desc: At-home fittings, wardrobe roadmaps and, when the occasion asks, a concierge for the day itself.

items.imageAlt: A wall of suiting cloth arranged by tone
items.title: The Fabric Wall
items.desc: Cloth arranged from bone to black, mill by mill.

items.title: The Fitting Mirror
items.desc: Where the suit and the man first meet.

items.title: The Consultation Table
items.desc: A whisky, the swatch books, and your story.

cta.heading:
Every NOIR suit begins
with a conversation.
